verdict: Meta delivered a lead surge this week; Google efficiency and pipeline conversion need attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 30 leads at a blended cost of $146.36 per lead — and this past week, lead volume doubled while cost per lead dropped 64.81% compared to the prior week, driven entirely by Meta. Google Ads remains the largest spend channel at $3,008.58 this period but logged only 5 conversions, a confirmed efficiency gap we are actively addressing by reallocating daily budget toward Meta where your cost per lead is lower. On the pipeline side, 30 leads entered your CRM this period but no appointments or closed opportunities are recorded, which points to an intake routing issue we are working to resolve now. Next week, you should see continued Meta momentum and a clearer read on whether the pipeline gap is closing.

blended cost per lead over the last 28 days, down 65% week over week

watch_item.issue: 30 leads arrived this period but zero appointments or won opportunities are showing in your pipeline, indicating a gap in how leads are being routed after they come in.
